_meta.title: Paradiso: New Home - official source registry
_meta.purpose: Structured registry of official nationality, naturalization, KIIP, and service handoff sources used by New Home.
_meta.method: Official page bodies and source identities were checked through bounded web and in-app browser review on the accessedAt date. Verification is scoped per record; handoff-only entries do not certify every page behind a portal.
_meta.verificationPolicy: contentVerified=true verifies only the stated scope. It never means that Paradiso has verified a user's eligibility, every linked subpage, every document list, or future amendments.
_meta.sourceHierarchy: Tier 1 law/statute; Tier 2 central MOJ/Korea Immigration/HiKorea/Socinet services; Tier 3 mission notices; Tier 4 government explainers.

sources.title: 출입국·외국인정책본부 국적과 업무 범위
sources.titleEn: Korea Immigration Service - Nationality Division scope
sources.navHintEn: About > Organization and functions > Nationality Division
sources.scopeKo: 일반·간이·특별귀화, 국적회복·판정·상실·이탈, 복수국적, 귀화적격심사 등 담당 업무의 공식 범위
sources.scopeEn: Official responsibility for general/simplified/special naturalization, restoration, determination, loss, renunciation, dual nationality, and naturalization review
sources.notes: Confirms the authority and category scope. It is not a personal eligibility or document checklist page.

sources.title: 법무부 온라인민원서비스 - 국적업무 유형별 안내
sources.titleEn: MOJ Online Civil Service - nationality service categories
sources.navHintKo: 민원안내 > 민원분야별 첨부서류 > 유형별 안내 > 국적업무
sources.navHintEn: Civil-service guide > by service type > nationality affairs
sources.scopeKo: 귀화 유형, 국적회복·판정·취득·선택·이탈·보유·상실, 면접자료, 우수인재 기준의 공식 진입점
sources.scopeEn: Official index for naturalization types, restoration, determination, acquisition, choice, renunciation, retention/loss, interview materials, and talent criteria
sources.notes: The page confirms service categories and routes users onward to HiKorea. Exact documents remain case- and route-specific.

sources.title: 국적 심사 진행상황 조회
sources.navHintKo: 하이코리아 > 전자민원 > 국적 심사 진행상황 조회
sources.navHintEn: HiKorea > e-Services > nationality review progress inquiry
sources.scopeKo: 귀화·국적회복 등 신청 후 진행상황 조회를 위한 공식 서비스 진입점
sources.scopeEn: Official service entry point for checking progress after a nationality-related application
sources.notes: The portal route can move. Confirm the current menu after opening HiKorea.

sources.title: 하이코리아 국적·귀화 안내
sources.scopeKo: 국적·귀화 절차, 서식과 민원 경로를 찾기 위한 중앙 공식 포털
sources.scopeEn: Central official portal for nationality/naturalization procedures, forms, and service routes
sources.jurisdictionEn: Republic of Korea - central civil-service portal
sources.notes: Use the current portal menu and confirm case-specific requirements before filing.

sources.title: 하이코리아 방문예약
sources.scopeKo: 관할 출입국관서 방문 전 예약 가능 업무와 일정을 확인하는 공식 서비스
sources.scopeEn: Official service for checking reservable tasks and appointments before visiting an immigration office
sources.notes: Availability and whether a reservation is required can differ by task and office. Confirm in the live service.

sources.title: 외국인종합안내센터 1345
sources.navHintEn: Korea Immigration Service > Immigration Contact Center 1345
sources.scopeKo: 출입국·체류 민원과 국내 생활정보에 관한 다국어 상담 및 관할 창구 확인
sources.scopeEn: Multilingual counseling on immigration/stay matters and routing to the competent channel
sources.jurisdictionKo: 전국 상담; 해외 연결 안내 포함
sources.jurisdictionEn: Nationwide contact service, including overseas dialing guidance
sources.notes: A counseling and routing service, not a substitute for a written decision by the competent authority.

sources.title: 사회통합정보망 (Soci-Net)
sources.navHintKo: 사회통합프로그램 신청, 과정신청, 평가신청, 이수 현황과 공지
sources.navHintEn: KIIP application, course application, assessments, completion status, and notices
sources.scopeKo: KIIP 과정·평가 신청과 최신 일정·공지의 공식 운영 포털
sources.scopeEn: Official operating portal for KIIP courses, assessment applications, current schedules, and notices
sources.notes: Schedules and notices change. Paradiso links to the live service and does not copy current dates into static content.

sources.title: 사회통합프로그램 평가
sources.navHintKo: 사회통합정보망의 평가 신청 경로에서 연결되는 평가 사이트
sources.navHintEn: Assessment site linked from the Soci-Net application route
sources.scopeEn: Application, schedules, and results for placement, midterm, permanent-residence, and naturalization assessments
sources.notes: Confirm current registration windows and result rules on the live site.

sources.title: 법무부 사회통합프로그램 안내
sources.navHintEn: Ministry of Justice > Social Integration Program
sources.scopeKo: KIIP 목적, 과정 구조, 신청 흐름과 체류·영주·국적 절차에서의 활용 가능성에 관한 중앙 제도 안내
sources.scopeEn: Central program overview covering KIIP purpose, course structure, application flow, and possible use in stay/permanent-residence/nationality processes
sources.jurisdictionEn: Republic of Korea - central policy overview
sources.notes: Benefits depend on the specific procedure. Completion or a score does not itself establish automatic eligibility or approval.

sources.title: 출입국·외국인정책본부 이민자 사회통합
sources.titleEn: Korea Immigration Service - immigrant social integration
sources.scopeKo: 사회통합프로그램의 교육 목적과 일부 사증·체류·영주·귀화 심사에서의 혜택 가능성
sources.scopeEn: KIIP educational purpose and possible benefits in some visa, stay, permanent-residence, and naturalization reviews
sources.jurisdictionEn: Republic of Korea - central policy overview
sources.notes: Confirms possible benefits, not automatic eligibility.

sources.title: 국적법 - 현재 시행 본문
sources.navHintKo: 법령명 국적법 - 현재 시행 본문과 시행일 확인
sources.navHintEn: Search Nationality Act and confirm the current effective text/date
sources.scopeEn: Legal authority for nationality acquisition, naturalization, restoration, choice, loss, renunciation, and dual nationality
sources.jurisdictionEn: Statute of the Republic of Korea
sources.notes: A separate amendment promulgated 2026-06-02 is scheduled for 2026-12-03. Do not pre-apply it before its effective date.

sources.title: 국적법 2026-06-02 개정문 - 시행예정 확인
sources.titleEn: Nationality Act amendment promulgated 2026-06-02 - future effective date
sources.navHintEn: Check the promulgation and effective dates separately in the amendment text
sources.scopeEn: Future-change signal: promulgated 2026-06-02 and scheduled to take effect 2026-12-03
sources.jurisdictionEn: Statute of the Republic of Korea - future effective text
sources.notes: Future effective law. It is displayed as an update signal and must not be treated as the current rule before 2026-12-03.

sources.title: 국적법 시행령
sources.titleEn: Enforcement Decree of the Nationality Act
sources.navHintKo: 법령명 국적법 시행령 - 현재 시행일 확인
sources.navHintEn: Search the Enforcement Decree and confirm its current effective date
sources.scopeKo: 국적법에서 위임한 신청·심사·신고 절차의 하위 법령
sources.scopeEn: Subordinate legal rules for applications, reviews, and declarations delegated by the Act
sources.jurisdictionEn: Presidential Decree of the Republic of Korea
sources.notes: Confirm current text and effective date on the official legal page.

sources.title: 국적법 시행규칙
sources.titleEn: Enforcement Rules of the Nationality Act
sources.navHintKo: 법령명 국적법 시행규칙 - 별지 서식과 시행일 확인
sources.navHintEn: Search the Enforcement Rules and confirm forms and the current effective date
sources.scopeKo: 신청서·신고서와 첨부서류 근거를 포함한 세부 절차 규칙
sources.scopeEn: Detailed procedural rules, including legal bases for forms and attachments
sources.jurisdictionEn: MOJ Ordinance of the Republic of Korea
sources.notes: Forms can be amended. Confirm the current attached form before filing.

sources.title: 대한민국 전자관보 - 국적·귀화 고시
sources.scopeEn: Individual official notices for naturalization, restoration, loss, renunciation, and related decisions
sources.jurisdictionEn: Official Gazette of the Republic of Korea
sources.notes: Search results are person- and notice-specific. Paradiso does not reproduce individual gazette notices.

sources.title: 찾기 쉬운 생활법령정보 - 국적
sources.navHintKo: 생활법령 > 국적; 최종 확인은 국적법령과 법무부 안내
sources.navHintEn: Living-law guide > Nationality; confirm finally against the Act and MOJ guidance
sources.scopeKo: 국적 제도의 쉬운 설명을 위한 정부 운영 보조 자료
sources.notes: Helpful for plain-language orientation, but Tier 1 law and Tier 2 MOJ/KIS sources take priority.
